svg.title: How Transcriberr works
svg.desc: Audio from the microphone, the call or a file goes through on-device speech engines, a diarizer and voice prints, then a local text model, and lands in a library that assistants can read through a read-only MCP server. Nothing leaves the Mac.
svg.text: Every step runs on the Mac.
Cloud engines exist for those who want them. They are off until you add a key.
one drift-compensated clock for every source
Meetings keep the mic and the call on separate tracks, so your own lines are always yours.
Neural Engine and GPU, never the network
two engines vote word by word,
Gemma 4 on MLX or Qwen3.5 on uzu, loaded only while it works
every run kept as a version, audio as AAC,
sidecars that round-trip with the Android app
read-only: AI assistants can search the
